source_metadata.title: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus Necrotizing Pneumonia
source_metadata.source_type: Letter / single-patient case report with molecular isolate characterization

atoms.canonical_statement: The letter reports and molecularly characterizes a case of necrotizing pneumonia caused by PVL-positive community-acquired MRSA in Italy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: To our knowledge, this is the first report from Italy of necrotizing pneumonia caused by PVL-positive CA-MRSA.

atoms.canonical_statement: The reported patient was a 37-year-old woman in Rome with an unremarkable medical history and no recent travel abroad.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: At the beginning of April 2005, a 37-year-old woman was admitted to the University Hospital Policlinico in Rome because of fever, cough, and headache. Her medical history was unremarkable.

population.label: 37-year-old woman in Rome
inclusion_criteria: hospitalized with fever, cough, and headache

atoms.canonical_statement: At admission, the patient had fever, tachycardia, tachypnea, and multilobar pulmonary infiltrates.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: At hospital admission, her temperature was 39°C, heart rate was 108 beats/min, respiratory rate was 32 breaths/min, and blood pressure was 105/70 mmHg.

population.label: 37-year-old woman hospitalized in Rome with necrotizing pneumonia

atoms.canonical_statement: At admission on room air, PaO2 was 73 mm Hg.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Arterial blood gas analysis showed mild hypoxemia and hypocapnia (PaO2 73 mm Hg and PaCO2 34 mm Hg on room air).

population.label: 37-year-old woman hospitalized in Rome with necrotizing pneumonia

concept.text: PVL-positive community-acquired methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus necrotizing pneumonia

outcome.measurement_method: arterial blood gas on room air

quantitative_result.original_result_text: PaO2 73 mm Hg on room air

atoms.canonical_statement: At admission, the leukocyte count was 24,360 cells/µL with 81% polymorphonuclear cells.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Leukocyte count was 24,360 cells/µL (81% polymorphonuclear cells), and platelet count was 506,000/µL.

atoms.canonical_statement: Empiric antimicrobial therapy consisted of clarithromycin plus ceftriaxone.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Empiric treatment with clarithromycin and ceftriaxone was started, but the patient’s clinical conditions did not improve.

atoms.canonical_statement: On hospital day 3, antimicrobial therapy was changed to linezolid, and the patient subsequently completed 14 days of linezolid treatment.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: On day 3 of admission, antimicrobial drug therapy was changed to linezolid. The patient was discharged after 14 days of linezolid treatment.

atoms.canonical_statement: The sputum MRSA isolate was susceptible to all tested non-beta-lactam agents, including erythromycin, clindamycin, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, kanamycin, and fusidic acid.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The MRSA isolate from sputum was susceptible to all the non–β-lactam antimicrobial drugs tested, including erythromycin, clindamycin, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, kanamycin, and fusidic acid.

population.label: 37-year-old woman hospitalized in Rome with necrotizing pneumonia

concept.text: PVL-positive community-acquired methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus necrotizing pneumonia

atoms.canonical_statement: Molecular characterization assessed SCCmec type and toxin genes, including lukS, lukF, and hlg.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: With established molecular methods, the isolate was found to harbor SCCmec type IV; lukS and lukF, the genes coding for the 2 subunits of the PVL toxin; and hlg, the γ-hemolysin gene.

atoms.canonical_statement: The isolate harbored SCCmec type IV, the PVL genes lukS and lukF, and the gamma-hemolysin gene hlg.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the isolate was found to harbor SCCmec type IV; lukS and lukF, the genes coding for the 2 subunits of the PVL toxin; and hlg, the γ-hemolysin gene.

concept.text: PVL-positive community-acquired methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus necrotizing pneumonia

atoms.canonical_statement: The isolate’s genetic background was characterized by multilocus sequence typing and spa typing.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The genetic background of the isolate was determined by multilocus sequence typing (MLST) and sequence typing of the tandem repeat region of protein A gene (spa typing).

atoms.canonical_statement: MLST assigned the isolate to sequence type 30, and spa typing assigned a novel spa type 755.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Results showed that the isolate belonged to ST30 according to the MLST database, and spa typing ... indicated a novel spa type, to which type 755 was assigned.

concept.text: PVL-positive community-acquired methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus necrotizing pneumonia

atoms.canonical_statement: The Italian isolate’s spa repeat pattern comprised seven repeats (XJ4AKAOM) and differed from the classical SWP pattern by one base pair in the second repeat and loss of the final Q repeat.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The spa type of the Italian isolate comprises 7 nucleotide repeats, indicated by XJ4AKAOM ... differs from that of the classical SWP clone ... by only 1 bp in the second repeat and loss of the last Q repeat.

concept.text: PVL-positive community-acquired methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus necrotizing pneumonia

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors interpreted the isolate as either a descendant or a local variant of the southwest Pacific clone.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the spa type is in substantial agreement with the MLST result and indicates that the Italian isolate is either a descendent or a local variant of the SWP clone.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors concluded that fusidic-acid resistance could not be relied on as a screening marker for PVL-producing community-acquired MRSA in Italy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: In light of our finding, we cannot rely on resistance to fusidic acid to screen for PVL-producing CA-MRSA in our country.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors described this as the first reported Italian case of necrotizing pneumonia caused by PVL-positive community-acquired MRSA.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: To our knowledge, this is the first report from Italy of necrotizing pneumonia caused by PVL-positive CA-MRSA.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors described this as the first report of a southwest Pacific clone isolate in southern Europe.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This is also the first report of a SWP clone isolate in southern Europe.

atoms.canonical_statement: The report could not determine whether the strain was circulating in Italy or was imported, nor how the patient acquired it.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: if the strain is circulating in Italy or is occasionally imported from the SWP area, whether our patient acquired it through contact with a foreign contact remains unknown.
